# GeoPilot plugin

Agents: `explainer`, `fixer`, `investigator`, `reviewer`, `scanner`. Commands (skills): `/geopilot:explain`, `/geopilot:fix`, `/geopilot:init`, `/geopilot:insights`, `/geopilot:review`, `/geopilot:scan`.

Engine: geopilot 0.0.1.

## Install

Claude Code:

    /plugin install geopilot --marketplace moelzanaty3/geopilot

or, on older versions:

    /plugin marketplace add moelzanaty3/geopilot
    /plugin install geopilot@geopilot

GitHub Copilot CLI:

    copilot plugin marketplace add moelzanaty3/geopilot
    copilot plugin install geopilot@geopilot

More: https://moelzanaty3.github.io/geopilot/docs/agent/
